value.rationale: The main diagonal is the unique central optimum in the motivating work; allowing off-center motion immediately improves it. The natural entire family admits a unique optimizer, an order-one offset limit, and explicit second-order normalized volume gain, providing a sharp constructive benchmark for the unrestricted high-dimensional cube-pyramid problem. This is not a routine numerical table entry or a disguised restatement of the positive derivative at the center.
